summary: Fixed the billing package against docs/: month-end period starts and leap-year February, inclusive used days, tier sorting by integer minimum, largest-remainder allocation, order discounts (percent before amount), discount amounts converted with the currency exponent, invoice-rounding tax summed exactly and rounded once, and credit-note request handling. Money arithmetic now uses exact fractions. All 82 unit tests pass, tools/reconcile.py reports no disagreements, and `python -m billing run` builds every document.
